Both are already linked to 230 common concepts, including monte carlo technique, feedback control and asymptotic approximation, which suggests the methods and data needed to connect them already exist. We propose a study that uses monte carlo technique as a bridge: first, review how numerical scheme and optimal trading are each currently treated through monte carlo technique; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.
